steps.text: Tuvalo is a camping lamp for outdoor trails, wild paths, dark hills, and long nights. It has a strong, solid build and a mass of 340 grams. USB charging brings 12 hours of bright light from full to low, and it can go in pools down to 2 m. It has black, sand, cobalt colour options and costs 49 dollars today at our shop.
